moc_large_hangar.note: large multi-bay hangar block, stepped roof (steps at about z -1945 and -1885); apron on the west and south; biggest single roof of the United Maintenance and Operations Center (MOC)

moc_barrel_hangars.note: two side-by-side barrel-vault (arched-roof) hangar bays south of the large hangar, doors on the west (aircraft parked on the west apron in NAIP); height not in the DOF
